experience.role: Senior Platform Engineer – AI Platform (Fraud Detection)
highlights: Architected a Ray-based distributed Python execution platform on Kubernetes that onboards real-time fraud-detection models onto streaming transaction profiles at ~100M transactions/day (500M peak); adopted by the modelling team for 3 models.
Designed a modular execution engine with DAG-based orchestration, parallel execution, actor pooling, queue-driven scheduling and configurable batch processing.
Built event-driven execution on Kafka (6 topics × 40 partitions across 3 data centres) with Redis-backed coordination, plus reusable Kafka, Redis, Grafana and OpenSearch integrations.
Engineered fault tolerance with dead letter queues, automatic retries, workload isolation and recovery; resolved Ray out-of-memory failures by automating Kubernetes worker restarts.
Positioned the platform as a lower-cost replacement for Flink jobs on low-load models: ~60% cost reduction, ~$250K/year saved per model (up to 5K TPS).
Led a team of 2 engineers from PoC to production; standardised CI/CD as a single Makefile workflow on Jenkins and Git.

Enterprise Data Products Platform (Technical Lead, 2022–2025): led 50+ data products on an Azure Databricks Medallion architecture (32 bronze, 12 silver, 9 gold), ~2 TB/day across 40+ orchestrated pipelines.
Market Supply & Demand Optimisation (2021–2023): distributed optimisation platform evaluating ~20B parameter combinations; runtime cut from 3 hours to under 2 minutes, ~$50M/year in savings.
Smart Layout Planning (2024–2025): automated plant fixture layout generation with mathematical optimisation; planning effort cut from 36 months to ~2 months, saving €500K per cycle.
Global Campaign Monitoring (2019–2021): modernised a semi-manual legacy system into an automated cloud pipeline; processing time 6h → 2h, reporting accuracy 70% → 99%+.
Standardised CI/CD on Azure DevOps across multiple applications; owned architecture and release management, and mentored engineers.
Won the Intern Showcase for innovation in risk assessment, competing against 40 interns.
Led testing for a mortgage project; earned client recognition for efficiency and the top first-year performance rating.
